authorization: User explicitly requested hosted CI validation and actual measurement, preserving coverage and forbidding publication/deployment. Dedicated feature branch pushes are solely CI inputs; no main update, PR, tags, releases, image/chart push or deploy dispatch.
scope: Exact combined working candidate on its original base; no merge with independently advanced main, which would change the experiment product.
trigger: push only opted-in CI branches; inspected all workflows, other automatic write/deploy paths require main/release/manual events. No PR side effects.
pipeline: Same ci.yml bytes for both; all four jobs and original commands/native schemes retained. Adds opt-in push branch route only.

populations.swift: All1166tests/146suites, identical tests in control and candidate; strict NIO=1 both
populations.python: All20checks both, including expected negative no-DNS regression failure on control
populations.apps: All four CI macOS/iOSSimulator local/beta builds, unsigned
populations.hub: Complete existing locked Rust format/clippy/test job

comparison: Control keeps all correctness/reliability fixes and identical tests, restores only B4 getfqdn bind and Foundation scratch listing. Measures the two latency changes; candidate validates the entire combined change. Not a comparison against original unsafe/flaky implementation.
control_expected_failure: Python no-DNS regression in lint must fail on slow control; acceptance remains failed, not waived. Package/full Swift workload must complete for latency comparison; failures/timeout retained otherwise.
metrics: Library test span and full count
Package job and full workflow spans
Aggregate job seconds by runner; dollar cost unknown
objective: Existing provisional>=10% relative Test-step median reduction; focused/local earlier results remain separate. With2runs/condition, report individual values and range; no dependable percentile or reliability probability.
sample_budget: At most2full attempts per condition (four total); initial control then candidate, then control/candidate reruns. No job-only reruns, shared cache purge, runner-class/worker change or extra services. Standard existing CI only; no spending configuration changes. Necessary correctness failures addressed explicitly before any further budget amendment.
cache: Existing cache keys/restore behavior unchanged; first attempts and second attempts recorded separately. Capture actual hit/restore labels; unequal image/cache observations preclude an unconditional causal gain claim.
holdout: Second full attempt on exact candidate SHA, no source edits between attempts.
required_gates: All candidate CIjobs/checks pass, no missing/empty/disappearing tests
Complete attempt ledger and measured boundaries
rollback: Candidate changes remain on isolated branch; no merge. Stop validation runs if safety trigger mismatch; retain attempts. Control code is experimental and must not be promoted.
